description: This file defines a Warn class responsible for handling warning and deprecation messages within the SCSSPHP library. It provides static methods to issue warnings, deprecation notices, and manage callback functions for reporting warnings. It includes methods for setting a callback, issuing warnings, and handling warning reporting internally, intended to be used within specific contexts like custom functions or importers.

classes.name: Warn
classes.description: A utility class for issuing and managing warning and deprecation messages in the SCSSPHP library.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Issues a warning message that can be called within a custom function or importer callback.

methods.name: deprecation
methods.description: Issues a deprecation warning message within a custom callback context.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function for handling warning messages, returning the previous callback.

methods.name: reportWarning
methods.description: Private method that invokes the callback with the warning message and deprecation flag.
